hertelCode: Hertel: OD, base and OS in one go (15-100-16)
barTip: Type code:finding, for example rc:1+ inj. Separate entries with ; and press Enter to save. Press ? for all shortcuts.
title: Keyboard and shorthand help
intro: Everything here also works with the mouse or touch. Press Esc to close.
kUndo: Undo the last change (when not in a text box)
kHelp: Show this help (? when not in a text box)
gField: code:finding writes a finding into a field.
gEye: r, l or b in front of a code: right eye, left eye or both eyes.
gAppend: .a at the end adds to what is already there instead of replacing it.
gNormal: D fills every section with your normal values; DEXT, DAS and DRET fill one section.
gSeparator: ; separates entries. Text with no code continues the previous field.
gHistory: POH, PMH, POS, MEDS, SURG and ALL add to the patient's history lists.
gEnter: Enter saves everything in the box. Esc closes the suggestions, then clears the box.
gSuggest: Up and Down choose a suggestion; Enter or Tab puts it in. Typing keeps filtering.
filterPlaceholder: Code or field, e.g. rc or cornea
noCodesSection: This section has no short codes. Try All sections.
fieldIdsNote: Every field name (such as ODCONJ) also works as a code.
kUndoAnywhere: Undo the last change (also in a text box)
kFocusMessage: Go to the undo message (Escape closes it)
kDimRoom: Dim room on or off (when not in a text box)
